leftEvidence.title: Two sticks become one under servant David

points.label: Action and response
points.left: Judah and Joseph are joined in one hand, the people are gathered and cleansed, one king and shepherd called David rules, and an everlasting covenant and sanctuary are promised.
points.right: A commanded purchase and waiting period are followed by an explanation that Israel will remain without king or cult objects and afterward seek the LORD and David their king.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The source places Davidic rule, reunification, covenant, and sanctuary are held together inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
points.right: The source places David’s name appears inside a future return after prolonged absence inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.

payload.posture: Ezekiel 37:15–28 and Hosea 3:1–5 are distinct approved David Scenes in the authored “Royal, Poetic, and Prophetic Memory” movement; holding them together exposes what continues and what changes without collapsing their sources.

rightEvidence.title: Israel later seeks the LORD and David their king

payload.tension: Ezekiel 37:15–28 foregrounds Davidic rule, reunification, covenant, and sanctuary are held together; Hosea 3:1–5 foregrounds David’s name appears inside a future return after prolonged absence. Their sequence does not by itself explain every change between them.
